methods.name: Multi-query Web Search
methods.description: Generates 5 variant search queries from the input, searches DuckDuckGo HTML for each, parses and deduplicates results by URL.

methods.name: Wikipedia API Deep Extraction
methods.description: Uses Wikipedia API to search articles, extract summaries, sections, references, and categories. Follows 'See also' links for breadth.

iteration2_benchmark.notes: Improved from 0 to 1 result vs iteration 1

methods.name: arXiv Academic Paper Search
methods.description: Uses arXiv API to find academic papers, extracts titles, authors, abstracts, categories, and dates.

iteration2_benchmark.notes: Now functional — improved from 0 to 9 results vs iteration 1

methods.name: Hybrid Multi-Source Aggregation v2
methods.description: Combines all 5 methods (web search, Wikipedia, arXiv, OpenAlex, Wikidata) into a parallel pipeline. Cross-references findings, applies credibility tiers, corroboration scoring, and TF-IDF deduplication.

iteration2_benchmark.notes: Best quality score. Faster than iteration 1 despite more sources due to parallel execution.

methods.name: Iterative Deepening Search
methods.description: Does 3 rounds of progressively deeper DuckDuckGo searching. Each round analyzes results to generate focused follow-up queries.

methods.name: OpenAlex Academic Search
methods.description: Uses the OpenAlex API to search 250M+ academic works. Extracts titles, authors, publication year, abstract, citation count, DOI, and open access URL. Sorted by citation count.

iteration2_benchmark.notes: Fastest academic source. Rich metadata including citation counts and DOIs.

methods.name: Semantic Scholar Paper Search
methods.description: Uses Semantic Scholar Academic Graph API to search papers. Extracts titles, authors, abstracts, AI-generated TLDRs, citation counts, fields of study, external IDs (DOI, ArXiv), and open access PDF links. Respects 1 req/sec rate limit.

methods.name: Wikidata Knowledge Graph Search
methods.description: Two-phase Wikidata search: finds entities via wbsearchentities, then fetches full details including labels, descriptions, aliases, instance_of/subclass_of claims, and Wikipedia sitelinks.

methods.name: GitHub Repository Search
methods.description: Searches GitHub repositories sorted by stars and code via REST API. Extracts full_name, description, stars, language, topics, license, forks, and open issues. Handles 403 rate limits gracefully.

utilities.name: Deduplication Utilities
utilities.description: TF-IDF-based similarity scoring, deduplication, and source merging. Importable by all methods.

utilities.name: Benchmark Runner
utilities.description: Runs all methods against a test query and collects performance metrics.
